data.name: Javeriahuma
data.gender_notes: Javeriahuma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic words 'Jawar' (humble) and 'Iahum' (mother). This name signifies a mother who is known for her humility and nurturing nature in Islam. The name Javeriahuma carries the meaning “Mother of the humble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Javeriahuma usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the humble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A mother's love and humility reflecting Allah's divine qualities.
data.etymology: Javeriahuma belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the humble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Javeriahuma total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جافريهوما
in_arabic.long_meaning: جافريهوما هو اسم مؤلف من جذرين عربيين، جفر الذي يعني الجمال، والثاني هو هوما الذي يعني السماء، وله意义 روحاني كبير في الإسلام حيث يرتبط بالسماء والملائكة

in_urdu.name: جاوریہوما
in_urdu.long_meaning: جاوریہوما کے دو حصے ہیں، جفر کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور هوما کا مطلب ہے آسمان، جو روحانی اور مذہبی طور پر اسلام میں بہت اہم ہے

in_hindi.name: जावेरियाहुमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: जावेरियाहुमा नाम दो अरबी मूलों से बना है, जفر जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और هوما जिसका अर्थ है आकाश, जो इस्लाम में उच्च आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है

in_pashto.name: جاوریهوما
in_pashto.long_meaning: جاوریهوما دوه عربي ريښو څخه جوړ شوی دی، جفر چې د ښکلا په معنا دی او هوما چې د آسمان په معنا دی، چې دا نوم په اسلام کې لوړ духовي اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Javeriahuma
